checks: ServerDetail.tsx displays Backup-Manager tab and renders BackupsView
RealBackupsView implements Backup-Manager with manual creation, list, search/filter, and 1-click Rollback
backend/backups.ts supports /rollback alias, pre-rollback safety snapshot, and autoStop
POST /backups creates manual backup with custom label, notes, fileCount, and SHA-256
GET /backups lists existing archives with totalSizeMb
POST /rollback stops running server, creates pre_rollback safety snapshot, and restores archive
Rollback atomically restores State v1 files and removes v2 artifacts
Pre-rollback safety snapshot can undo a rollback cleanly
DELETE /backups/:backupId removes archive and metadata cleanly
